title: Agent-count-independent VIB workflow scalability
summary: Don't change the way an agent uses VIB. Change the way VIB handles multiple agents using it. Preserve Head → Worker → Validate → Internal Auditor → Head for each independent owner-authorized assignment; qualify one to 100 simulated clients without requiring a fixed team or new agents. Retain stable issue versions, exact evidence, dedicated installation branch and owner authority.
benefits: Independent ChatGPT or compatible agent sessions do not require another thread to coordinate or validate routine work.
Persistent issue-level state and conflict-safe version allocation preserve progress and reduce redundant coordination.
Preserve existing Solo behavior and qualify scalability without delaying the current release.
risks: Concurrent claims or stale writes may duplicate checkpoint assignments or lose state unless atomic non-force updates and idempotent retry are verified.
Overlapping changes may invalidate evidence; lane isolation cannot eliminate real code dependencies.
Self-review is not independent review, and Standard VIB does not enforce GitHub merges.
Unbounded expansion may delay releases; qualify 1–100 simulated clients, separate real host trials and measure actual completion benefit.

evidence.claim: Existing source defines one active Worker; future qualified migration changes only the global active slot restriction, not the five-stage workflow.
All six ecosystem laws remain in force; no mandatory coordinator or dependencies.
Original single-writer idea is preserved as historical context and Solo mode.

decision.reason: Owner approved the architecture direction; timestamp records public decision issue creation, not exact chat approval time. See https://github.com/vixttha/Version-Issues-Hub/issues/53. No implementation, integration or release acceptance is asserted. Owner subsequently locked the exact scalability principle in issue #53 on 2026-11-25; five agents was an example, not a deployment plan. Research only; no active release or installation changes authorized.
